main_text.head: CAPITUM.
main_text.l: Hysterologia methodica instar turbati in syllogismo ordinis 564.22 & 567.19
Crypsis poetica incipere à medio, & ibi comprehendere antecedentia, & inopinatè concludere 562.29 & 567.22 & deinceps.
Crypsis oratoria firmissima primo summoq; loco ponere, mediocria medio 563.21 & 571.28
main_text.head: FINIS.
PETRO RAMO D D D.
main_text.p: Turbida cùm Veneris celebraret Gallia festum Nuper, & in dapibus dira venena daret: Præcepere ratas tædas Hymenæus Amorq;, Tectis mentiti serta & ubiq; lyras.
Aurea utrinq; vocant bipatentibus atria valvis Convivas: sed Mars sponsus & hospes erat.
Et Bellona ferox immissos crinibus angues Hospita, convivis invidiosa procis.
Bellonæ junctus crudeles actus in iras Mars, manibus versans tela inimica suis.
Manera, nunc animam sponsis pro dote, rependat Quisq; suam, jam nunc Ægide, dixit, opus.
Non lacrymas precium ve, preces, cum sanguine vitam Poscimus. hîs dictis, ensis & arma micant.

page.notes: Verse lines are italic in the print; the Greek-free dedication is set in italic. Some letters are worn, e.g. "Manera" and "Ægide" read as printed with doubtful letters. The contents list uses figures as printed.
